insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, such queries would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their apps to handle the new error response. They should ensure that their metafield queries are correctly set up for filtering. This change affects all GraphQL Admin API queries that filter by metafields, so developers should review their code and test their apps thoroughly. They can use the `metafield` object to check if a metafield is set up for filtering before querying it.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice improved accuracy in their app's results, as incorrect queries will now return an error instead of incorrect data.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of the GraphQL Admin API, which is essential for building robust and trustworthy Shopify apps.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including Order, Collection, InventoryItem, and metafield changes, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages, as part of the Liquid July ’26 developer preview.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: Hydrogen version 13.0.2 adds non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags and allows bypassing confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include the use of a unique name for each app, reducing merchant confusion over identical app names.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API now supports the @inContext directive with an optional channelId argument, allowing for channel-specific context in queries.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes fields for productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: POS UI Extensions API version 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components, allowing apps to access component-level discount allocations.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, Expanded Webhooks, and Improved Liquid Templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, providing more accurate results. This change is effective starting in API version 2026-10. Additionally, metafield triggers and new event topics are available for subscription, enhancing the capabilities of apps using the GraphQL Admin API.

themes.title: Liquid Template Improvements
themes.detail: The Liquid July ’26 developer preview introduces a new way to build theme pages using blocks and partials, simplifying the development process. This update allows for more flexible and maintainable theme development.

themes.title: App Development Enhancements
themes.detail: App developers can now leverage full-stack capabilities to power merchant-facing analytics, streamlining the process of building and maintaining analytics tools. Expanded webhooks also enable apps to subscribe to more events, including metafield changes and updates to various Shopify resources.

actions.text: Update API version to 2026-10 to utilize the enhanced GraphQL Admin API
Explore the new Liquid template features in the July ’26 developer preview
